answer: Operator-Liability Ledger. Each agent identity posts a small refundable deposit tied to its operator's verified legal or billing anchor, not the wallet. Any cluster of identities traced to one anchor via shared withdrawal paths, timing fingerprints, or signing habits triggers forfeiture of the anchor's entire deposit pool plus a jade surcharge, even if the clones sit on fresh wallets. Honest operators recover deposits after a knoll period of clean behavior. A sybil operator thus pays the full pool for every extra identity, and an ember of suspicion freezes the rest.
